summary: Monitor Windows IIS with Grafana Alloy and the IIS integration: configure counters, install Alloy, verify metrics, install dashboards, review alerts.

needs.description: Windows Server with IIS role installed and running, admin privileges, outbound HTTPS to *.grafana.net.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: A Windows Server with the IIS role

needs.description: Grafana Alloy installed on the Windows host with a Cloud token.
IIS (windows_iis_*) metrics present in stack metrics datasource for verify/explore steps.
Microsoft IIS integration available in Connections catalog.
